description: Federal and California income tax rules the simulator's progressive tax model uses (see taxes.py and tax/README.md). Brackets are [upper bound of taxable income, rate] pairs, the last with no bound (null). A year missing here, or a jurisdiction missing from a year, uses the nearest year that has it. Tax rules change: check these against the sources before relying on them, and add each new year as it is published.

sources.federal_2025: IRS, Federal income tax rates and brackets (irs.gov/filing/federal-income-tax-rates-and-brackets); IRS Topic 409 for long-term rates; standard deduction as amended by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
sources.federal_2026: IRS newsroom, tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2026 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32)
sources.niit: IRS Topic 559: 3.8% above $200,000 single or head of household, $250,000 married filing jointly (not indexed)
sources.california_2025: FTB 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules (ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540-tax-rate-schedules.pdf); standard deduction from FTB Tax News, October 2025. The 2026 schedules were not yet published (October 2026), so 2026 uses 2025's.

federal.notes: Head of household 24%/32% boundary taken as 201,775 (the source read lists both 201,775 and 201,750); unverified.
